name: naipepea
_comment: What naipepea SHOULD have. It runs plain develop and the suite targets one root workspace created through
Configurator signup, so its masters come from the platform baseline (backend/pgr-services onboarding
platform-baseline-v1.json) plus the workspace's onboarding steps, and its personas from scripts/seed-personas.ts.

_rationale.workflow.pgr.actions.ESCALATE: The platform baseline's PGR businessService defines ESCALATE, so #521 must run here.
_rationale.mdms.rejectionReasons: The platform baseline seeds RAINMAKER-PGR.RejectionReasons; absence is a baseline regression.
_rationale.personas.gro-with-department: seed-personas.ts creates a departmented GRO; without it nothing can be ASSIGNed.
_rationale.personas.ward-scoped-csr: seed-personas.ts creates a ward-scoped CSR, so boundary-jurisdiction-496 must run, not skip.
_rationale.locales.multi: Depends on the languages chosen at signup.
_rationale.identity.citizen.google: Citizens sign in by phone OTP only (identity_citizen_signin_methods: [phone_otp]); the Google cases are N/A.
